summary.priorityFormula: Priority = axis-weighted Impact × Innovation / log2(EffortHours + 2). Game engagement weight 3x, UI and speed/organization 2x, other selected axes 1.5x.
summary.theme: The game is already broad, deterministic and visually coherent. The next leap is not more disconnected surface area: make verification non-mutating, expose progression truth at the position-room level, turn exact play receipts into a player-directed broadcast, convert hidden accomplishments into an honest next-goal path, give the season a receipted decision reckoning, and stop loading the entire mature UI graph before the first General Manager decision.

gameLoopReview.evidence: Structural scores only. No cohort retention or conversion telemetry is invented. Progression is below the other axes because the global mean can pass while a position room silently inflates or collapses; retention is below 8 because trophies exist but the next attainable goal is not surfaced in the weekly loop.

recommendedMoves: First make the suite hermetic: a verification run must prove the tree without rewriting the tracked startup brief.
Then add position-room parity and the lazy UI boot boundary so the simulation and loading architecture become measurable before new presentation layers depend on them.
Finally ship the player-payoff trio as one coherent arc: direct the broadcast, pursue the next honest trophy, and end the year with an Architect's Cut of the decisions actually made.

items.title: The green aggregate suite mutates a tracked source-of-truth file
items.premise: The recovery began from an exactly clean tree. npm test passed 857/857 but test/startup-authority-contract.test.js spawned scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs in the repository root, rewriting docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md with the current meter. A green proof therefore leaves a dirty tree and can contaminate a later commit.
evidence: Clean status immediately before npm test; a three-line STARTUP_BRIEF context-meter diff immediately after it
The live renderer test runs with cwd root and reads the tracked output after the subprocess
items.constraint: Reuse the Studio no-write CLI and guarded artifact patterns. Preserve production renderer behavior and do not weaken the live source-bound assertions.
verification: focused startup-authority contract test
npm test leaves git diff empty
renderer default still writes the canonical brief

L1.recipe: Back up and restore STARTUP_BRIEF.md inside the test.

L2.recipe: Add an explicit validated output-path override to the renderer, aim the live contract at a test-owned temporary file, assert the tracked brief hash is unchanged, and cover malformed or out-of-root output paths as no-write failures.

L3.recipe: L2 plus register the renderer in the Studio no-write CLI contract and route writes through a local atomic guarded-artifact helper.

items.title: The season grades outcomes but not the General Manager's own decision trail
items.premise: Season Epilogue already grades predictions, arcs, records and fan sentiment. The league also owns receipted Architect weekly plans, transactions, draft verdicts, trades and General Manager decisions, but no season-end surface selects and replays the year's most consequential player-authored calls with their exact before/after evidence.
evidence: seasonEpilogue loads arcs, records, fan sentiment and Time Capsule only
dashboard exposes architectLedger, transaction log, recent decisions and receipted outcomes
Architect decision semantics already forbid causal claims, so the missing boundary can be descriptive and honest
items.constraint: Do not claim a decision caused wins or development. Rank only source-derived committed calls, name the observed result, and show missing evidence as incomplete.
verification: pure model tests for ranking and non-causal wording
season-end browser rendering
mobile one-column capture in dark and light themes

L1.recipe: Append the last three transaction lines to the epilogue.

L2.recipe: Build a bounded Architect's Cut model that joins committed weekly plans, trades, draft calls and General Manager choices to their existing receipts; rank three turning points, render declared intent versus observed evidence in Season Epilogue, and keep explicit non-causal and incomplete states.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a cross-season decision anthology with player-selectable chapters and export-safe cards.

items.title: Sim-Watch is a fixed 280ms slideshow, not a player-directed broadcast
items.premise: Sim-Watch owns exact play-by-play, scoring, field state and rivalry framing, but exposes only Skip and Close. Playback always advances every 280ms, cannot pause, cannot change speed, cannot jump to the next score or turnover, and catches all failures silently.
evidence: runSimWatch has one fixed setTimeout(280) loop
game.html exposes only simWatchSkipBtn and simWatchCloseBtn
The play and scoring receipts already contain the authority needed for key-play navigation
items.constraint: Controls must never change the simulation or reconstruct scores. They direct presentation of the archived exact receipt only; cancellation and a second open must not leak timers.
verification: pure playback-controller tests
Playwright pause/speed/key-play journey
desktop and mobile dark/light pixel captures

L1.recipe: Add a speed selector around the existing delay.

L2.recipe: Extract a deterministic playback controller with play/pause, 0.5×/1×/2×/4× speed, previous/next key play and quarter/drive progress; wire accessible controls and keyboard shortcuts, preserve exact score/field receipts, and surface replay failures through client diagnostics.

L3.recipe: L2 plus an optional broadcast mode with drive chapters, rivalry callouts and shareable final key-play reel.

items.title: Twenty-nine trophies exist, but the weekly loop cannot name the next attainable one
items.premise: The Trophy Case truthfully evaluates and stores 29 achievements, yet the only summary is earnedCount/total and the case lives deep in History. The populated mobile loop shows owner, fan, league and next-snap pressure but no persistent career objective or source-derived progress toward one.
evidence: Achievement checks are functions with prose descriptions but no shared progress authority
Populated mobile capture has a clean pressure stack and room for one compact career path without adding a modal
items.constraint: No daily streak, invented XP or hidden rewards. Progress must come from live standings, receipts and existing trophy thresholds; unmeasurable trophies say the next qualifying event rather than a fake percentage.
verification: questline selection/progress unit tests
Overview and mobile rendering
unlock automatically advances the next-goal set

L1.recipe: Show the first three locked trophy descriptions.

L2.recipe: Add declarative progress metadata for measurable trophies, derive the three nearest honest objectives from live dashboard and receipt state, render a compact Trophy Road on Overview and mobile, and advance it immediately after an unlock without inventing percentages for event-only goals.

L3.recipe: L2 plus player-pinned quests and a cross-franchise trophy constellation export.

items.title: The first decision imports the mature 58-module UI graph up front
items.premise: Engine code is lazy, but public/app.js statically imports every tab presenter, exports, History, Settings, Gist, timeline, newsletter and engagement surface before the first General Manager decision. The last committed build measured an 821KB boot payload even though most tabs are not visited in a short session.
evidence: public/app.js is 95KB and statically imports every tab module at the top level
The browser reachability contract reports 58 modules, all reachable from the initial app graph
The populated desktop first view needs Overview, state, navigation and weekly-command authorities, not every History and Settings exporter
items.constraint: Static-host and offline safe. Lazy boundaries must keep service-worker manifests, browser reachability, error observability and tab hydration exact; no user action may race an unresolved import.
verification: source-derived boot manifest with byte/module budgets
first-view Playwright flow
visit every lazy tab and offline smoke
no browser-module orphan

L1.recipe: Measure boot modules and fail on accidental growth.

L2.recipe: Create a source-derived boot budget, dynamically import at least History and Settings/export islands on first activation, centralize pending/error behavior in the hydration dispatcher, update precache/reachability contracts, and prove first decision plus every lazy tab.

L3.recipe: L2 plus split the remaining secondary tabs and record real browser transfer/parse timings against a checked-in baseline.

items.title: A flat league mean can hide one position room inflating while another collapses
items.premise: Session 72 proves active-player mean overall drift is within ±0.15 per year for one deterministic decade. summarizeLeagueProgression aggregates every position together and the receipt has one global status. Position rooms have different age distributions, roster churn and potential profiles, so offsetting drifts can satisfy the league target while breaking a room.
evidence: summarizeLeagueProgression returns global distribution and age cohorts only
ROSTER_WINDOW_GROUPS already defines seven stable football rooms
The realism verifier already owns deterministic start/end player states and can compute segment receipts without another simulation
items.constraint: Do not retune the development profile unless multi-seed evidence proves a real breach. Small or empty samples are incomplete, not pass; preserve the global contract as a separate top-level verdict.
verification: seven-room deterministic receipt tests
multi-seed measurement history
Commissioner table and mobile readable state
global pass cannot mask a room fail

L1.recipe: Print start/end mean by raw position.

L2.recipe: Promote the seven roster rooms into a shared authority, compute count/mean/median/elite and annual drift per room, classify inadequate samples as incomplete, add a multi-seed comparison history without rerunning on render, and expose global plus room verdicts in Commissioner Settings.

L3.recipe: L2 plus versioned room-specific target bands derived from several declared calibration seeds and a tuning history that can explain every profile revision.

Once Architect's Cut has a pure model, cross-season chapters can become an export without changing simulation state.
